title: Take Two (with sujoyku)
author: Calump
rules:
Created as part of an event on the Sudoku Skunkworks server where I was paired up anonymously with sujoyku, who was a pleasure to work with!

The task was to create a puzzle with ambiguity and duality, and I hope you enjoy solving what we managed to put together.

Sudokupad link: Click Here

Rules:

• Normal sudoku rules apply.

• Clues outside the grid are combinations of X-Sums, Sandwich, and First Seen Odd/Even, with two of the three types applying to each clue.

• X-Sums:
Numbers outside the grid indicate the sum of the first X digits in the corresponding direction, where X is the digit in the closest cell to the clue.

• Sandwich:
Numbers outside the grid indicate the sum of the digits that are placed between the 1 and 9 in that row or column.

• First Seen Odd/Even:
Clues outside the grid tell you the first odd and/or first even digit seen in that row or column, from the direction of the clue. Two digit numbers should be read as two separate digits for this clue type.

Enjoy!
